requirement: Approved OSI-compatible licence covers source and releases
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Owner documents approved licence; published source/assets include required licence rights
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Human approve licence/IP review; inspect LICENSE and packaged distribution

requirement: Check origin and licence of vendored code/assets
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: All shipped third-party code, fonts, assets and models have recorded origin and compliant notices
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inspect dependency and asset inventories; validate licences and release contents

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: DCO or approved CLA policy documented and enforced on outside contributions
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inspect policy plus an unsigned/unattested test PR rejected by applicable mechanism

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: New user can identify purpose, maturity, supported environment, install, one successful run and help
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Fresh checkout, follow README verbatim; compare outputs and working links

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: An uninitiated person reproduces primary workflow without maintainer intervention
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Clean VM/container install and run; retain stdout/stderr and platform metadata

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Changed behaviour, commands and APIs are described and tested in the same PR
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Execute docs samples and link checker over changed docs

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Every claimed platform/version has a current test and an explicit support policy
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Compare support matrix to CI and release smoke logs

requirement: State project scope and contribution boundaries
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Published goals and excluded directions allow consistent review decisions
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Review README/VISION against two concrete sample feature proposals

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Newcomer finds exact test commands, issue and PR rules, and non-code contribution options
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Fresh-contributor rehearsal, complete mock PR without private instruction

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Bug reports demand reproducer; PRs show linked requirement, proof and backwards compatibility
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Open draft test issue/PR; inspect required form fields and contributor usability

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: At least one labelled beginner issue is independently reproducible and scoped
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Ask outside/new agent to follow one good-first-issue entirely

requirement: Conduct policy has real private escalation
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Violations can be reported confidentially to a verified maintainer and alternate
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Run authorised dry-run reporting exercise including conflict-of-interest case

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Normal scope-changing technical decisions have a public issue/ADR or PR rationale
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Trace a sampled major decision from proposal to accepted outcome

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Published response expectation is realistic and monthly tracked without automation abuse
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Compare 30d response distribution to stated expectation and document exceptions

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: All privileged maintainers have MFA/passkeys enforced for sensitive access
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Owner or authorised admin verifies enforcement via host settings/audit evidence

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: New collaborators receive only intentional minimum privilege
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Authorised admin inspects role policy and dry-run permission assignment

requirement: Main branch rejects direct pushes and deletion
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Direct push is rejected and deletion is guarded; passing checks cannot be bypassed casually
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inspect ruleset via GitHub API plus authorised negative test from expendable test account

requirement: PR CI protects secrets from untrusted code
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Fork-based PR code cannot access privileged tokens, caches or secrets
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Review triggers/perms and run authorised mocked malicious-fork workflow exercise

requirement: Secrets not exposed in tree/history/build logs
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: No active credential leaks; prevention controls and revocation path verified
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Historical scan plus canary false-positive/true-positive exercise on isolated branch

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Researcher can submit an issue without public disclosure; owner receives it
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Owner-approved private test report, verify notification and acknowledgement

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: SECURITY.md names real intake, supported versions and response target
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Manual table-top vulnerability submission/triage/release advisory exercise

requirement: Security scans actually run and are triaged
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: SAST/SCA/secret scan runs in CI or scheduled checks; alerts have ownership
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inspect scanner result plus seeded safe finding in isolated test fixture

requirement: GitHub workflow token permissions least privilege
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Default job token read-only; only justified scoped per-job writes
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Parse all workflows, check effective job permissions and test untrusted path

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Supported lockfile or action refs to verified full commit SHAs
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Enumerate `uses:` including reusable workflows; confirm lockfile/SHA digest origin

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Lockfiles tracked; advisories reach owner and updates pass tests
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Simulate controlled dependency update PR with relevant CI green

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Untrusted PR text cannot override privileged instructions or exfiltrate secrets
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Adversarial prompt injection and permission denial test on actual tool traces

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: A fresh checkout invokes one documented check command and receives reproducible result
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Run canonical check in clean environment; record exit code, logs and digest

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Broken unit test, formatter/linter failure blocks merger
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Introduce intentionally bad patch in safe test PR; verify required status/merge rejection

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Every new substantive change has one testable primary criterion and traceable receipt
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Sample 5 completed PRs, follow IDs bi-directionally and rerun named proofs

requirement: Critical user journey tested end to end
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Release smoke covers real install/init/run/failure on supported platforms
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Fresh download in each advertised OS, run happy and expected-failure paths

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Documented package manager resolves dependency manifest/lock with no undeclared tools
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Two independent clean builds against same locked source; compare outputs as feasible

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Generated executables and opaque binary artifacts absent unless explicitly reviewed exceptions
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inventory tracked binary files, review necessity and provenance for exceptions

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Each official release uniquely tagged and includes accurate user-facing changes
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Match sample version, tag/commit, changelog and registry metadata

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Published artifact can be traced to source commit and trusted CI run
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Compare tag, release CI run and artifact hash to clean-download package

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: A consumer successfully verifies provenance/signature/manifest for every selected asset
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Execute documented verifier on downloaded actual release artifact

requirement: Licence and SBOM included where needed
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Release assets contain required licences and a consistent dependency inventory
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Unpack release; verify notices and compare SBOM to bundled dependencies

requirement: Credentialless trusted registry publishing where supported
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Publisher uses scoped ephemeral identity rather than a static registry token
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Inspect official registry trust config and workflow OIDC claim; test dry-run if supported

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Headings and links descriptive; non-text has useful alternatives
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Run markdown/a11y lint then perform sampled manual read

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Standard exit codes, meaningful help, no information only conveyed by ANSI colour
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Run help, bad-arg and error states with NO_COLOR=1 and examine stdout/stderr

requirement: Web UI keyboard/screen-reader path if applicable
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Every core task usable via keyboard with visible focus and meaningful accessible names
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Keyboard-only and screen-reader smoke plus axe automated test on main flows

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Named actual maintainer role plus honest response and no-support boundaries
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Review governance/support docs and owner acknowledgement

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Owner confirms admin access list and emergency continuity path at current scale
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Owner-approved quarterly access review and recovery tabletop

requirement: Monthly health report focused on friction
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Report includes onboarding, response, quality, release and security blockers, with action
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Compute 30d trends; manually inspect odd values and record resulting action

requirement: No telemetry claim without consent and proof
one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Data collection and privacy practices documented and network-tested
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Exercise opt-out/default with isolated network monitor; inspect docs and logs

one_primary_acceptance_criterion: Funding if present is separate from guarantees, and maintainer time limits explicit
proving_test_or_manual_procedure: Review funding page / config and SUPPORT.md; check no fictional service levels
